stories.title: US forces and Iran attack oil tankers in Strait of Hormuz as oil heads to $100
stories.summary: Iran's IRGC says it targeted two US vessels and eight oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz while US forces struck Iranian tankers, pushing crude toward $100 a barrel. The attacks escalate a direct US-Iran confrontation that threatens a vital global shipping lane and oil supply.

stories.title: Two killed at Moldova's border as Russia and Ukraine exchange drone strikes
stories.summary: Russian drones struck the Starokozache checkpoint on the Ukrainian-Moldovan border, killing two civilians, as both sides traded new strikes (five deaths in Ukraine, four in Russia). The cross-border spillover heightens risks along Ukraine's western flank near NATO member Romania.

stories.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
stories.summary: Apple's chief executive argued the iPhone remains the best device for AI as the company pushes on-device intelligence. It signals Apple is betting phones, not standalone AI gadgets, will win the AI-device race.

stories.title: 'Gambling with our lives': Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
stories.summary: A researcher resigned from Anthropic warning publicly that self-improving AI systems amount to 'gambling with our lives.' It highlights growing unease that AI capability is advancing faster than safety and oversight.

stories.title: Instacart launches an AI grocery shopping assistant called Clementine
stories.summary: Instacart rolled out Clementine, an AI assistant that helps with grocery shopping and planning. It adds Instacart to the growing wave of apps embedding AI shopping copilots.

stories.title: Sequoia doubles down on Cymphony as AI agents create new enterprise security risks
stories.summary: Sequoia increased its stake in Cymphony, a startup that protects enterprises against threats from autonomous AI agents. The deal reflects surging demand for guardrails as companies deploy agents at scale.

stories.title: Jaguars fans: Is the Week 1 Browns matchup a trap game?
stories.summary: With Jacksonville installed as about 8.5-point home favorites over Cleveland for Sunday's opener, a Jaguars fan survey debates whether the game is a trap. The spread signals the market backing the home side against the Browns on the road.

stories.title: All eyes on the Jaguars: live Browns updates from Sept. 9
stories.summary: The Browns opened game week ahead of Sunday's season opener at Jacksonville, with coach Todd Monken addressing the media and an open locker-room session as the team preps for its first game of 2026.

stories.title: Ohio State Week 2 preview: Offense must take a step vs. Texas
stories.summary: A breakdown of what the Buckeyes' offense needs to improve ahead of Saturday night's trip to face a CFP-contending Texas. It's a far bigger test than Week 1's 56-3 win over Ball State.

stories.title: College football Week 2 streaming guide: Ohio State-Texas leads the slate
stories.summary: A guide to watching the biggest game of Week 2: No. 1 Ohio State at No. 4 Texas on Saturday night, where Arch Manning and the Longhorns host the Buckeyes. Details how to catch the marquee matchup.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event?
stories.summary: A look at the man accused of attacking Dr. Amy Acton at a campaign event, part of a developing political incident in Columbus. The alleged attack has drawn attention ahead of the election season.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who had pleaded guilty in a deadly road-rage shooting reversed his plea after retaining new counsel. The move resets the case in a high-profile local prosecution.

stories.title: Central Ohio events marking the anniversary of 9/11
stories.summary: A list of Columbus-area memorial ceremonies, including volunteers placing flags at the Ohio Statehouse, marking the anniversary of the September 11 attacks. Ceremonies are set for this week's observance.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: Popular Bexley restaurant The Lion is planning a dog-friendly outdoor expansion. It's the latest hospitality addition in the restaurant-friendly suburb east of Columbus.
